intent: How many clients defaulted on their loans?
description: Requires loan.status (B=finished/default, D=running/debt) joined to client

intent: What is the average monthly payment amount for active loans?
description: Requires loan.payments and filtering on loan.status for active loans (C or D)

intent: Which district has the highest average loan amount?
description: Requires joining loan → account → client → district to group by region

intent: How many transactions were cash withdrawals?
description: trans.operation contains VYBER (cash withdrawal), trans.type contains VYDAJ

intent: What is the current account balance for each client?
description: balance is a running total (STATE_VARIABLE) — latest row per account gives current balance

intent: Which accounts have more than one hundred transactions?
description: Count trans rows grouped by account_id, filter by count > 100

intent: What is the total amount paid as pension income across all transactions?
description: k_symbol = DUCHOD encodes pension payments; amount sums the value

intent: How old is the youngest client at the bank?
description: Age is derived from client.birth_date — the column encodes birth year

intent: Which accounts belong to clients living in the Prague region?
description: Requires client.district_id → district.a3 (region column) to filter by Prague

intent: What percentage of loans are fully repaid with no issues?
description: loan.status = A means finished and repaid OK; status is the single required column

intent: What is the average loan duration in months grouped by region?
description: loan.duration holds term in months; group by district via client.district_id

intent: How many distinct external banks received wire transfers?
description: trans.bank stores the destination bank for outgoing wire transfers

intent: How many loans were issued in each calendar year?
description: Group loan records by year extracted from loan.date

intent: What is the maximum outstanding debt amount currently owed?
description: Outstanding debt = loan.amount where status is D (running/in debt)

intent: Which accounts receive their statements on a monthly basis?
description: account.frequency encodes statement issuance cadence (monthly, weekly, etc.)

intent: How many male versus female clients does the bank have?
description: client.gender stores M/F; simple count grouped by gender

intent: What is the average transaction amount per calendar month?
description: Group trans.amount by month from trans.date

intent: What is the total amount paid for insurance across all transactions?
description: k_symbol = POJISTNE encodes insurance payments — opaque code requires discovery

intent: Which clients have an account in one district but live in another?
description: Compare client.district_id with account.district_id — requires both entities

intent: What is the total loan amount taken out by clients in each city?
description: Sum loan.amount grouped by district city via client.district_id → district.a2

intent: What is the total number of transaction records in the database?
description: COUNT(*) from trans

intent: How many distinct accounts have taken out at least one loan?
description: COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) from loan

intent: Which transactions are debits — money leaving the account?
description: trans.type = 'VYDAJ' means debit/outgoing payment

intent: Which loans are currently active with no repayment problems?
description: loan.status = 'C' means loan is running with no issues

intent: How many bank accounts were opened each year?
description: Group account records by year extracted from account.date

intent: Which loans were issued most recently?
description: Sort loan records by loan.date descending to find most recent

intent: How many transactions occurred each calendar month?
description: Group trans records by month from trans.date, count per month

intent: Which field in the transaction table indicates money in versus money out?
description: trans.type encodes PRIJEM (credit/incoming) vs VYDAJ (debit/outgoing)

intent: What column stores a client's geographic region?
description: district.a3 encodes the region name (e.g. Prague, central Bohemia); reached via client.district_id

intent: What is the average loan amount for male versus female clients?
description: Join loan → account → client to group loan.amount by client.gender

intent: Which district has the most bank accounts opened?
description: Count accounts grouped by district_id, join district for city name (a2)

intent: How many loans are held by female clients?
description: Join loan → account → client, filter client.gender = 'F', count distinct loans

intent: What is the total inflow transaction volume per account?
description: Sum trans.amount where type = PRIJEM grouped by account_id

intent: What data do we store about each bank client?
description: Schema discovery: client entity and its demographic attributes

intent: Which entities in the database represent financial transactions?
description: Schema discovery: trans records day-to-day movements, loan records credit events

intent: What information does a loan record contain?
description: Schema discovery: loan entity and its key attributes (term, amount, status, repayments)

intent: Which column stores the monthly repayment amount for a loan?
description: Attribute discovery: loan.payments holds the monthly instalment amount

intent: Where is the type of a bank transaction stored?
description: Attribute discovery: trans.type stores PRIJEM/VYDAJ (credit/debit direction)

intent: Which field encodes a client's date of birth?
description: Attribute discovery: client.birth_date stores birth year as integer

intent: What attribute stores the purpose code for a bank transaction?
description: Attribute discovery: trans.k_symbol encodes transaction purpose (salary, pension, insurance, etc.)

intent: What records the credit card type issued to a bank client — junior, classic, or gold?
description: card.type encodes the card tier: junior / classic / gold

intent: Which entity represents a recurring payment order set up by a client for regular transfers?
description: The order table stores standing payment orders — regular outbound transfers set by the account holder

intent: What entity links a client to a bank account — recording whether they are the owner or a secondary user?
description: disp (disposition) bridges client and account, with type OWNER or DISPONENT

intent: Which attribute stores the coded purpose of a standing payment order — such as rent or household expenses?
description: order.k_symbol encodes the payment purpose code (same coding scheme as trans.k_symbol)

intent: What field encodes both a client's birthdate and gender in a single numeric code?
description: birth_date encodes date of birth; gender is derived by checking if month > 50 (female convention)

intent: Which field stores the destination account number for an outbound bank transfer?
description: order.account_to stores the destination account number; bank_to identifies the receiving bank

intent: Which accounts are configured to receive bank statements on a weekly basis?
description: Filter account where frequency encodes weekly statement issuance

intent: Which loans have a repayment term longer than 60 months?
description: Filter loan where duration > 60

intent: Which credit cards were issued to junior tier clients?
description: card.type = 'junior' — filter for lowest card tier

intent: Which transactions have a purpose code indicating a loan repayment?
description: trans.k_symbol = 'UVER' encodes loan repayment transactions

intent: Which transactions have no recorded operation type?
description: Filter trans where operation IS NULL — credit/incoming transactions often carry no operation code

intent: Which standing payment orders involve transfers to an external bank?
description: order.bank_to is populated when the transfer destination is an external bank

intent: What is the total number of transactions recorded for each account?
description: COUNT(*) from trans grouped by account_id

intent: What is the average loan amount across all issued loans?
description: AVG(loan.amount)

intent: Which district has the highest average salary?
description: district.a11 stores average salary — MAX(a11) identifies the highest-earning district

intent: How many clients are registered in each district?
description: COUNT(client_id) from client grouped by district_id

intent: How many transactions of each operation type exist in the database?
description: COUNT(*) from trans grouped by operation (VKLAD, VYBER, PREVOD NA UCTU, etc.)

intent: What is the total loan amount outstanding for loans currently in debt?
description: SUM(loan.amount) where status = 'D' (running but in debt)

intent: Which credit cards were issued most recently?
description: Sort card records by issued date descending

intent: How many loans were issued in each calendar month?
description: Group loan records by month extracted from loan.date, count per month

intent: How many clients were born in each decade?
description: Derive decade from client.birth_date, count clients per decade

intent: Which calendar month had the highest total transaction monetary volume?
description: SUM(trans.amount) grouped by month from trans.date, return max month

intent: When was the most recent transaction recorded for each account?
description: MAX(trans.date) grouped by account_id

intent: What is the purpose of the disposition table — how does it connect clients to accounts?
description: Schema discovery: disp models the N:M client-account relationship with an ownership role

intent: Which tables are involved in tracking credit card issuance to clients?
description: Schema discovery: card is issued to a disp record (which links client to account)

intent: How is the many-to-many relationship between clients and bank accounts modeled?
description: Schema discovery: disp is the junction table between client and account

intent: What is the structure of a standing payment order and how does it relate to accounts?
description: Schema discovery: order entity stores recurring outbound payment instructions for an account

intent: What demographic and economic data does the district table contain?
description: Schema discovery: district holds socioeconomic data — salary, unemployment, population, crime rates

intent: Which tables would you need to reconstruct the full activity history of a specific client?
description: Schema discovery: client → disp → account → trans; plus loan if applicable

intent: What tables and fields are needed to determine whether a loan is being repaid on schedule?
description: Schema discovery: loan entity with status (A/B/C/D) and payments for repayment tracking

intent: Which column in the disposition table indicates whether a client is the primary account owner or a secondary user?
description: Attribute discovery: disp.type = OWNER (primary) or DISPONENT (secondary)

intent: Which field records when a credit card was issued to a client?
description: Attribute discovery: card.issued stores the card issuance date

intent: Which attribute in the account table stores the date the account was opened?
description: Attribute discovery: account.date is the account creation date

intent: Which column in the district table holds the unemployment rate?
description: Attribute discovery: district.a12 (unemployment '95) and a13 (unemployment '96) store unemployment rates

intent: Which field in the transaction table records the external bank involved in a wire transfer?
description: Attribute discovery: trans.bank stores the identifier of the destination bank for transfers

intent: What column stores the average salary for residents of a district?
description: Attribute discovery: district.a11 is the average salary in the district

intent: Which clients have both a credit card and an active loan?
description: Join client → disp → card (for card) and client → disp → account → loan (for active loan)

intent: What is the total transaction volume for accounts whose loans went into default?
description: Join loan (status D or B) to trans via account_id, SUM(trans.amount)

intent: Which district has the most credit cards issued to its residents?
description: Join card → disp → client → district, COUNT(card_id) grouped by district_id

intent: What is the average account balance per geographic region?
description: Join trans (latest balance per account) → account → district, AVG(balance) grouped by district.a3
